general_medicine.scope: Adult illness with no clear single organ system, first contact, general unwellness, routine checks. Absorbs GP, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Geriatrics.
in_examples: tired for three months and I've lost weight without trying
fever and body aches for four days now
I feel generally unwell, I think I need blood tests

near_misses.text: burning when I urinate
chest pain spreading to my arm

pediatrics.scope: Child complaints where age itself is the routing driver: general child illness, feeding, growth, development, newborns. NOT a catch-all for every child.
in_examples: my 2 year old has a fever and won't eat anything
newborn keeps vomiting after every feed
my son is 4 and much smaller than other kids his age

near_misses.text: my 8 year old's teeth are crowded
my child's ear hurts and he keeps pulling it

dentistry_general.scope: Teeth: decay, pain, fractures, fillings, crowns, extractions, cleaning, implants, wisdom teeth, jaw and TMJ. Absorbs Endodontics, Prosthodontics, OMFS, Oral Medicine.
in_examples: my back tooth hurts badly when I drink something cold
I chipped my front tooth eating
wisdom tooth area is swollen and I can't open my mouth properly

near_misses.text: my gums bleed every time I brush
I want my teeth straightened

orthodontics.scope: Tooth alignment and bite: braces, aligners, spacing, crowding, jaw position.
in_examples: my teeth are crowded and I want braces
thinking about Invisalign, how much does it cost
my top teeth stick out over my bottom teeth

near_misses.text: my tooth cracked
I want my teeth whiter

periodontics.scope: Gums and tooth-supporting structures: bleeding, recession, gum disease, loose teeth.
in_examples: my gums bleed every time I brush my teeth
my gums are receding and my teeth look longer than before
swollen gums and bad breath that won't go away

near_misses.text: my tooth is sensitive to cold
I'm missing a tooth and want an implant

dermatology.scope: Medical skin, hair, and nail conditions: rashes, acne, moles, hair loss, infections.
in_examples: itchy red scaly patches on my elbows for weeks
a mole on my back has changed colour and shape
acne that isn't improving with anything from the pharmacy

near_misses.text: I want filler in my cheeks
rash and swelling right after eating shellfish

plastic_aesthetic.scope: Elective cosmetic alteration and reconstructive surgery: injectables, body contouring, rhinoplasty, hair transplant.
in_examples: I want botox for my forehead lines
considering a nose job, want a consultation
hair transplant, my hairline is receding

near_misses.text: a mole has changed colour
my hair is falling out in patches

obgyn.scope: Pregnancy, childbirth, female reproductive system, menstrual and menopausal issues, fertility (female).
in_examples: my periods are extremely painful every month
I'm 8 weeks pregnant and need my first checkup
bleeding between periods for the last two cycles

near_misses.text: we've been trying to conceive, the problem is with my husband
burning when I urinate, no other symptoms

cardiology.scope: Heart and circulation, non-emergency: rhythm, blood pressure, exertional symptoms, known heart disease follow-up. Absorbs cardiac, cardiothoracic, vascular surgery, electrophysiology.
in_examples: my heart races when I climb one flight of stairs
pharmacy said my blood pressure is 160 over 100
my ankles swell up by the end of every day

near_misses.text: crushing chest pain right now
breathless with wheezing and a cough

gastroenterology.scope: Digestive tract and liver: reflux, bowel habit, abdominal pain (non-acute), liver. Absorbs Hepatology.
in_examples: burning in my upper stomach an hour after eating
loose motions for three weeks now
the whites of my eyes have gone yellow

near_misses.text: sudden severe stomach pain, I can't stand up straight
I want to lose weight

orthopedics.scope: Musculoskeletal injury and structural problems: joints, bones, spine, fractures, sprains. Absorbs Podiatry, Sports Medicine.
in_examples: my knee hurts every time I go down stairs
shoulder pain, I can't lift my arm above my head
twisted my ankle playing football, it's swollen

near_misses.text: I need rehab exercises after my knee surgery
multiple joints stiff for an hour every morning

physiotherapy.scope: Rehabilitation, movement, posture, and recovery: post-operative, post-injury, chronic mechanical pain management.
in_examples: I need physio after my knee replacement
my neck is stiff from sitting at a desk all day
the doctor told me to start rehab exercises for my back

near_misses.text: I fell and can't put weight on my ankle
sudden back pain with numbness down my leg

ophthalmology.scope: Eyes and vision: vision changes, eye pain, redness, discharge, floaters, screening.
in_examples: my vision has been blurry for about a month
red itchy eye with sticky discharge in the morning
I keep seeing floaters and small flashes

near_misses.text: I've suddenly lost vision in one eye
itchy scaly rash on my eyelid

ent.scope: Ear, nose, throat, hearing, balance, sinuses, voice. Absorbs Otolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery, Audiology.
in_examples: blocked nose and facial pressure for three weeks
ear pain and everything sounds muffled
my voice has been hoarse for over a month

near_misses.text: sneezing and itchy eyes every single morning
sore throat with fever since yesterday

urology.scope: Urinary tract in both sexes, male reproductive system, kidney stones. Absorbs Andrology, Urosurgery, Genito-Urinary Medicine.
in_examples: burning and stinging when I urinate
I'm getting up three times every night to urinate
blood in my urine this morning

near_misses.text: swelling in my legs and frothy urine
no periods for three months and pelvic pain

neurology.scope: Brain and nervous system: headache, seizures, numbness, weakness, tremor, dizziness, memory. Absorbs Neurosurgery, Neuro and Spine.
in_examples: headaches most days for the last two months
numbness and tingling in both hands, worse at night
my hand shakes when I try to hold a cup

near_misses.text: the worst headache of my life, came on suddenly
dizzy for a few seconds when I turn over in bed

pulmonology.scope: Lungs and breathing: chronic cough, wheeze, breathlessness, sleep apnoea. Absorbs Respiratory Medicine, Chest Medicine, Thoracic Surgery, Sleep Medicine.
in_examples: a cough that hasn't gone away in six weeks
I wheeze at night and wake up short of breath
my wife says I snore and stop breathing in my sleep

near_misses.text: I can't breathe properly right now
breathless when walking, with swollen ankles

endocrinology.scope: Hormones and metabolism: diabetes, thyroid, adrenal, pituitary, metabolic disorders.
in_examples: I'm diabetic and my sugar levels are out of control
my thyroid blood test came back abnormal
gaining weight, always cold, hair falling out

near_misses.text: I want a diet plan to lose weight
irregular periods with facial hair growth

psychiatry.scope: Mental health: mood, anxiety, sleep, attention, behaviour, addiction. Absorbs Counseling.
in_examples: I feel anxious all the time and can't sleep
low mood for months, no interest in anything
my son can't focus at school and his teacher suggested an assessment

near_misses.text: tired all the time, no other symptoms
can't sleep because of back pain

nephrology.scope: Kidney function and disease: abnormal kidney results, kidney failure, dialysis, fluid retention of renal origin.
in_examples: my kidney function test results came back abnormal
swelling in my face and legs, and my urine is frothy
I'm on dialysis and need a follow-up consultation

near_misses.text: burning when I urinate
severe pain in my side, comes in waves

general_surgery.scope: Conditions typically managed operatively by a general surgeon: hernia, gallbladder, appendix, lumps, piles, GI surgery. Absorbs Laparoscopic, Gastro-intestinal Surgery.
in_examples: a lump in my groin that bulges when I cough
pain under my right ribs after eating oily food
bleeding when I pass stool, and something comes out

near_misses.text: sudden severe abdominal pain with fever
heartburn and acid coming up my throat

allergy_immunology.scope: Allergy and immune response: hay fever, food and drug allergy, hives, recurrent infections. Absorbs Immunology.
in_examples: sneezing and itchy eyes every morning, worse in dusty places
rash and lip swelling after eating nuts
my child comes out in hives whenever we visit my sister's house

near_misses.text: my throat is closing up and I can't breathe
dry itchy patches with no obvious trigger

rheumatology.scope: Autoimmune and inflammatory joint and connective tissue disease: multi-joint, symmetrical, prolonged morning stiffness.
in_examples: several joints stiff for over an hour every morning
my fingers and wrists have been swollen and painful for months
I was told I have lupus and need ongoing management

near_misses.text: one knee hurts after I run
back pain since I lifted something heavy

nutrition.scope: Diet, weight management, sports and clinical nutrition, feeding advice. Self-referred lifestyle requests.
in_examples: I want to lose weight, where do I start
I need a diet plan that works with my diabetes
my 5 year old refuses to eat anything but rice

near_misses.text: gaining weight despite eating very little, always cold and tired
I've lost weight without trying to
